item.title: Reliable and Trustworthy Automated Software Engineering
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on automated software engineering approaches that prioritize reliability and trustworthiness. The collection aims to bring together research addressing the challenges of developing software engineering tools and techniques that can be confidently relied upon in practice.

Appel publié par Journal of Systems and Software. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
